verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own docs say every change runs in a live, shareable preview where teammates can 'hop in, watch it build,' and that a live preview can be opened for any task in progress. This gives real-time visibility into what the agent is producing, but the docs never describe a live agent activity stream or an explicit agent status indicator; ticket-state management is only adjacent. Captured screenshots and videos are after-the-fact review, not real-time monitoring. Missing for 10: a documented real-time agent activity/log view, an explicit current-status indicator for running agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Every change runs in a live, shareable preview. Anyone on the team can hop in, watch it build, and weigh in.
Open a live preview for any task in progress without affecting production.
